notes.title: Aeterna Lucis is coming in September 2025: Wishlist now and join the adventure!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/504f815cc04a4d4a39603eb011e1f14b2692c692.jpg[/img]
The wait is over! Aeterna Lucis is coming this year with your support!

We have some exciting news that many of you have been eagerly awaiting: the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis, titled Aeterna Lucis, will officially arrive this year! Specifically, you'll be able to dive into this new adventure starting September 2025 on all platforms.

Continuing our beloved tradition, Aeterna Lucis will feature two distinctive difficulty modes: the Lucis Mode, crafted to be extremely challenging, demanding, and rewarding, preserving the spirit of the iconic original Noctis mode, and offering an intense platform-focused experience; and the Aeterna Mode, more relaxed and accessible, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in a metroidvania experience with a calmer pace and deeper exploration. It's truly like having two games in one!

We're especially excited to announce that the first official gameplay preview is already available on our official Aeternum Game Studios YouTube channel, showcasing thrilling new mechanics, stunning visuals, and hints of what awaits you in this epic sequel.

[h2]
Wishlist it now using this direct link and help us reach even greater heights![/h2]

We can't wait to hear your comments, suggestions, and thoughts about what you're seeing. You're an essential part of this journey, and together we'll make Aeterna Lucis the incredible game we all dream of.

The adventure continues, and we want to share it with you. Wishlist Aeterna Lucis now and join us on this exciting new journey!

notes.title: ¡Descubre el Bundle "Metroidvania en la Oscuridad"!
notes.content:

[h1]Attention, Metroidvania lovers!
[/h1]We are pleased to announce the launch of the ultimate bundle: "Metroidvania in the Darkness." This is a unique opportunity to acquire three gems of the genre that you cannot miss in your collection. Get ready to immerse yourself in exciting adventures full of action, challenges, and exploration.

[h2]Blasphemous[/h2]
Dive into the world of Blasphemous, a game that will take you on a dark and visceral experience. With its stunning artistic style and unique atmosphere, Blasphemous offers challenging combat that will test your skills. Face hordes of enemies, uncover hidden secrets, and experience the epic story of Penitence as you battle grotesque creatures. The intense gameplay and the combat system that rewards precision will make every battle unforgettable.

[h2]Aeterna Noctis
[/h2]Step into the beautiful world of Aeterna Noctis, where exploration and platforming are masterfully combined. This game offers you an immersive experience with its detailed art and deep narrative. Control the Dark King and overcome a variety of challenging obstacles on a journey that will take you through stunning environments. With its fluid gameplay and secrets hidden in every corner, Aeterna Noctis is a masterpiece of the genre that you won't want to miss.

[h2]Deviator [/h2]
Finally, Deviator provides you with a unique experience with its parry system, which adds a new dimension to gameplay. This challenging title will allow you to master the art of dodging and counterattacking in intense battles against formidable enemies. With ingenious level design and mechanics that encourage learning and skill, Deviator is the perfect complement to complete your Metroidvania experience.

[h2]Don't miss out![/h2]
Don't miss the chance to acquire the "Metroidvania in the Darkness" bundle and immerse yourself in these three unique experiences. Share this news with your friends and get your copy today. The darkness awaits you—get ready for the adventure!

notes.title: "Most Wanted" Update - 6 Days Left
notes.content:
Dear players,

There are only a few days left to finish the campaign and we want to show you more details about the incredible “Most Wanted Ghost” reward. It would be great if you don't miss the opportunity to be eternal in Eden Genesis.

[h2][b]What is the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward in Eden Genesis?[/b][/h2]

During the game, Leah will get access to the Eden Genesis central system where the data of the most wanted and dangerous Ghosts on the network is stored. High-ranking hackers whose reward would grant millions to anyone offering information about them. Thanks to this reward you will be one of these Ghosts, becoming part of the game and its story.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/97d412dc32efa7abc40699a87762664331f840ab.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]How is the “Most Wanted Ghost” card created?[/b][/h2]

Our team will ask you for an image of yourself or even a pet, as well as characteristics of the image, references or details that allow us to create together a memorable Ghost file. Since a picture says more than a thousand words, here are some examples.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/273f412062843a935d4fd8732c890ef56a71928d.jpg[/img]

They look amazing, right? Well, it is only possible to be a Ghost in Eden Genesis and become part of our game forever through the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward, whether in its Early or Standard mode. You will also get a Collector's Edition and the digital version of the game, besides the soundtrack and other stuff…

There are only a few days left... We rely on your support to reach the next stretch goal and make Eden Genesis an even better game with your contribution.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure/rewards#reward-UmV3YXJkLVVtVjNZWEprTFRrM01qVTBOams9]See Now Reward "Most Wanted Ghost"[/url]

We are preparing more news for the upcoming days, so stay tuned because the last few days will be frantic.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Eden Genesis has reached its Kickstarter goal in record time
notes.content:
Our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure]Kickstarter campaign[/url] reached its fund goal in just over 48 hours after the release!

Great news for the whole dev team, and we’d like to thank you all for making it possible in record time. It’s been months of hard work and getting funded in a matter of hours means a lot to us. We were confident about it, and as a token of gratitude, let’s take a look at some of the most important stretch goals we prepared for our lovely community.

The campaign for this cyberpunk platformer hides tons of surprises, including both physical rewards and extra in-game content. You’re about to learn about the first two, one that includes more gameplay options, and the other focused on getting a more immersive experience … Excited enough?

[h2][b]New tier reward[/b][/h2]

It is an expansion of the Level A Ghost (+Physical) tier but adding a digital copy of Eden Genesis for Steam. The new tier is called “Level A Ghost Plus (+Physical)”, and it has been created thanks to the feedback from the community on social media.

Thanks for your constant suggestions and contributions to the project! If you want to access this new reward at an incredible price, visit [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure/rewards#reward-UmV3YXJkLVVtVjNZWEprTFRrNE9ESTROek09]this link[/url].

[h2][b]First stretch goal, a replay and practice mode[/b][/h2]

Each trial in Eden Genesis is different from the last, presenting a unique level design and enemy presence. Your ultimate goal is achieving the best score by eliminating all hostile entities, cleaning the SND and keeping your synchro levels at maximum.

Thanks to this stretch goal you can practice adding your own checkpoints to familiarize yourself with the level. The training mode will allow you to perfect your reflexes and marks when you come to a test that seems too complex or in which you do not obtain the expected results.

By being able to add and remove checkpoints at will, you will not need to repeat the entire level. Focus on that section that you are struggling with, and practice as much as you want until you are completely familiar with the enemy layout and platform design.

[h2][b]Second stretch goal, dubbing[/b][/h2]

Eden Genesis is more than a fast-paced platformer, it also features a deep story and in order to make it more immersive, we aim to get full English dubbing for in-game dialogues.

Wish to know more? As soon as the first stretch goal is done, we’ll share more details about it…

Once again, thank you so much for your support. Let’s make the replay and practice mode a reality 😊

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/ea199714fa530df1973958eeeda54fd725d90343.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.0.001
notes.content:
[b]Base game[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where metal platforms would get stuck in the battle against the Phoenix
[*]Removed a prompt that appeared behind some map vendors
[*]You can now attack with the Katana vertically up and down when playing with the keyboard
[*]Katana cooldown time has been adjusted: 0.1s -> 0.3s
[/list]
[b]Virtuoso DLC[/b]
[list]
[*]The Erudite achievement can be unlocked when you complete the base game quests (including "Pit of the Damned") + the "Virtuoso" one
[*]The no-hit achievement can now be unlocked when facing the sword in Boss Rush mode
[*]Fixed an issue where fogs of war would disappear from games started when playing the DLC
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed skill points to be duplicated in Boss Rush mode
[*]Fixed an issue where the King of Darkness would get stuck when healing in Mythic
[*]Fixed a bug in the Sword fight in mythic where the King of Darkness would sometimes disappear when entering portals
[/list]
[b]Easy Anti Cheat has been removed[/b]

Aeternum Game Studios has decided to remove the EAC feature from Aeterna Noctis to ensure full accessibility to players and also in response to the demands of the community.

We understand that the addition of this functionality has not been well-received by certain sectors, and has also posed a problem for those players who for accessibility reasons have not been able to enjoy the title.

Instead, we have designed our own anti-cheat system that only applies to the leaderboards of the timed trials. This way, the stats obtained will remain legitimate without affecting the rest of the content of Aeterna Noctis, that is, gameplay elements and features that are single-player.

We have always listened to the community. This has been one of our hallmarks as a dev team. It is thanks to your suggestions that the Aeterna Universe has never stopped including improvements based on player feedback. The message was clear, EAC was an addition that was not liked and now it is history.

We would be very grateful if, just as you have expressed your disagreement with the inclusion of EAC, now that it has been removed from the title, you would also share it on the Steam forum and the rest of the networks, so that the news reaches all players. We trust that this decision will allow Aeterna Noctis to be valued solely for its playable values.

Long live the King of Darkness!

notes.title: Aeterna Noctis "Virtuoso" is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Content included in Aeterna Noctis "Virtuoso"[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589720/Aeterna_Noctis_Virtuoso/

[h2]New game mode[/h2]
Aeterna Noctis: Virtuoso features the long-awaited boss rush mode. Now players can repeat the boss fights from the base game including new enemy behaviour and attack patterns.

During these battles, your powers will be restricted to ensure a fair duel, this way, you will also be able to perform feats that you may not have achieved in your first encounter: defeating bosses in a particular way or without getting hit.

If you prefer an even greater challenge you can face them one after the other.

The Collector is the NPC that introduces the boss rush mode to players. Visit his true collection and overcome the different challenges and boss groups until you defeat all of them in every modality.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39578084/c4b22956984de8a9574bc0ac28c84f716ee891ee.png[/img]
[h2]New boss fight[/h2]
The Clockwork Twins are the new bosses included in the DLC. They can be found (and beaten) in the boss rush mode, offering an encounter only recommended for the most skilled players.

This brand-new final boss features unique mechanics that will put your reflexes to the test. You must face these monstrosities in an exclusive arena.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39578084/f111456a0a866060cd93e91ec9c2370f5d209b28.png[/img]
[h2]New achievements[/h2]
A new batch of achievements has been included thanks to Aeterna Noctis: Virtuoso. Believe us when we say that some of them are only accessible to true champions of the Darkness.

notes.title: Aeterna Noctis prepares for the imminent "Virtuoso" DLC
notes.content:
Thanks to this update, Aeterna Noctis is now ready to allow access to the "Virtuoso" content, which will be available next Thursday, November 9.

You can now enjoy some free additions on the occasion of the imminent launch of the Boss Rush DLC. Let's see what this update includes:

[h2]More accessibility[/h2]
We've included a "How to Play" section to provide a shortcut to movement and combat controls by simply pausing the game and accessing this index.

No matter how long you haven't played or whether you have questions about the King of Darkness's movement options, you can now consult all the control information thanks to the "How to Play" section, including images and descriptions.

[h2]Remixed OST[/h2]
All of the songs that accompany final boss fights in the base game have been updated with the remastered versions included in "Virtuoso." If you have started a new game, all boss fights now feature improved background music.

These new versions will also be available in the DLC battle room.

[h2]Changes to the base game[/h2]
The way the Lance of Cycles works has been changed by adding a 2 seconds cooldown. This way, its handling becomes more balanced.

They have also made some performance improvements, and fixed minor bugs reported by the community.

[h2]Aeterna Noctis "Virtuoso"[/h2]
The Boss Rush DLC for our Metroidvania will arrive next week, available on November 9 on Steam and consoles. Add it to your wish list!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589720/Aeterna_Noctis_Virtuoso/

notes.title: Free DLC "Pit of the Damned" is now available
notes.content:
[h1]"Pit of the Damned": New Content and Improvements[/h1]

[h2][b]New areas[/b][/h2]

2 new areas have been added:
[list]
[*] Pit of the Damned: An old underground vault that has been unexplored for cycles. Who knows the mysteries and dangers hidden in its collapsed galleries and burial chambers... 

[*] Belly of the Beast: An inhospitable area, with organic walls and throbbing floors... An ancient evil dwells inside, and has just awakened from its lethargy.

[*] Artificial Dimensions: A brand new area accessible through portals scattered throughout the Aeterna Noctis map. It is an artificial environment, a vestige of an ancient civilization that disappeared years ago...
[/list]Thanks to these additions, Aeterna Noctis features 19 unique and interconnected areas!

[h2][b]New challenges available[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Timed trials: A series of trials that will put your skills to the test, making a total of 12 spread across the game map. Within these challenges, your skills will be restricted, and you will have the chance to compete to beat your own mark... and against other players!

[*] Multiplayer leaderboard: Stand out in world statistics thanks to the multiplayer and cross-platform scoreboard incorporated into this new game modality
[/list]
[h2][b]New missions[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] No Whip and Hat: Help Lord Drake VI explore some ancient catacombs located under the Wasteland of the Fallen

[*] The Legacy of a Cursed Lineage: The Pit of the Damned hides more than just resentment and death. Find your way into the depths of the excavation and face your destiny

[*] Breach in the Matrix: Find all entrances to the Artificial Dimensions
[/list]
[h2][b]Modifications in base game missions[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The Art of the Collector: Changed the percentages needed to advance in each mission state

[*] The Soul Mirror: No longer drops the gem "Sleight of Hand" as a final reward
[/list]
[h2][b]New enemies[/b][/h2]

The Pit of the Damned is inhabited by both old acquaintances and new creatures:
[list]
[*] Blade Vassal
[*] Dynastic Sentinel
[*] Protector of the Invictus
[*] Tomb Rodent
[*] Mole Wasp Hive
[*] Mole Wasps
[*] King Worm
[*] Symbiotic Globule
[*] Intestinal Basophil
[/list]Defeat these enemies and add them to your collection. Obtain them all 

[h2][b]New final bosses[/b][/h2]

A terrible evil dwells in the depths of the Pit of the Damned...

Face your destiny and discover the horror that inhabits the catacombs by facing the 2 new final bosses included, adding a total of 19 in the entire game

[h2][b]Gameplay adjustments[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new zone in the Cosmos area accessible only through the teleport gate
[*] Game progress has increased beyond 100%, reaching 109% (max percentage)
[*] Certain enemies have been recalibrated to make them easier to obtain in the collection
[*] Shooting assist sight is now enabled by default and can be disabled from the options menu
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Leech" and "The Vampire's Soul" gems would sometimes not work correctly
[*] Adjusted the "Guardian Angel" skill to restore 30% of your health in Noctis Mode and 70% in Aeterna Mode
[*] Certain platforming sections have been recalibrated to better match the difficulty
[*] Dragons now do not deal damage when hit from above
[*] Fixed a bug where the soul retrieval tutorial would sometimes not appear correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Edge of the Master" weapon would sometimes not damage certain enemies
[*] Fixed several bugs that prevented unlocking certain achievements
[*] Fixed a bug where some bosses did not feature their life bar represented in the damage pop up
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes enemies would not resurrect correctly
[*] The "Guardian Angel" skill now recharges when visiting a throne
[*] Fixed a bug where Enraged Spirits' death particles would sometimes remain on death
[*] Fixed a bug where player stats were sometimes not reflected correctly in the skills menu
[/list]
[h2][b]New gems[/b][/h2]

3 gemas azules:
[list]
[*] Crystallized Soul: You do not lose your soul after being defeated
[*] Vertigo: Adds an extra jump charge
[*] Mortal Temptation: Increases your damage by 100%, but you are defeated in one hit
[/list]
2 purple gems:
[list]
[*] Last Resort: The Dark Shield activates automatically when you are hit, but its recharge time is doubled
[*] Gluttony: Increases your damage by 50% when your blood pools are at maximum
[/list]
1 red gem:
[list]
[*] Phantom Dash: You are invulnerable while using the Rush, this effect has a 4 second cooldown
[/list]
[h2][b]Modifications on base game gems[/b][/h2]

The behavior of some gems has been modified:
[list]
[*] Celestial Lens: Automatically aim at the nearest enemy
[*] Sorcerer's pact: You heal automatically if you have enough blood available
[*] Soul of Amaterasu: The Edge of the Master will execute a larger and more powerful cut
[*] Soul of Susanoo: Doubles the damage dealt by the feint
[*] Infinite Flare: Spear of Cycles now does not consume blood when used
[*] Sagittarius Eye: Adds an additional projectile to each shot
[/list]
The obtaining method of certain gems has also been modified:
[list]
[*] Bloodthirsty Ruby: Now obtained by playing 8 piano scores
[*] Prestidigitation: Can now be purchased from Asnur's shop after defeating the T-900
[/list]
[h2][b]Modifications on base game weapons[/b][/h2]
[list]

[*] Spear of Cycles: 
[list]
- Removed the charge time when executing the spear attack
- The Dark King is now invulnerable while executing this attack
- Falling speed has been increased
[/list]

[*] Edge of the Master:
[list]
- The recovery time after performing an attack has been reduced
- Removed the stall time after performing a feint
[/list] [/list]
[h2][b]New achievements[/b][/h2]

Added 18 new achievements
[list]
[*] Master of Ceremonies: Interpret all the musical scores on the piano
[*] Take your time: Complete all simulations on bronze level
[*] Professional Speedrunner: Complete all simulations on platinum level
[*] Against the clock (x13): Complete each simulation on platinum level. There is a different achievement for each numbered simulation
[*] 2 hidden achievements related to the story of the Pit of the Damned
[/list]
5 complimentary achievements have been added to the many others that were already present in the base game:
[list]
[*] Tourist info point +: Find and read every lore point in Pit of the Damned
[*] Well gifted +: Get as many skill points as possible in the Pit of the Damned
[*] Infinity Gems +: Obtain all power gems in the Pit of the Damned
[*] Gotta obtain them all +: Complete the bestiary collection including all creatures from Pit of the Damned
[*] Erudite +: Complete all quests in the Pit of the Damned
[/list]
[h2][b]Miscellany[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance has been optimized in all game areas
[*] Adjusted lighting in all areas
[*] Errors have been corrected in the texts and descriptions
[*] Fixed a bug where the elevator in Cradle of Light would sometimes not work correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where the number of gears was not displayed in certain languages during the quest "Crystal Elevator"
[*] Changed death animation after falling into traps
[*] Changed the price of the hilt in the Asnur shop
[*] Fixed a bug where the aim assist crosshair was not displayed correctly in certain areas
[*] 13 new songs have been included that provide background music to the new areas and environments
[*] 4 new collectable sheet music have been added. Find them all and interpret them on the piano
[/list]

notes.title: Summary of the Aeternum Game Studios showcase
notes.content:
[h1]Summary of the Aeternum Game Studios showcase[/h1]

[previewyoutube=3Van4s7jnhA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]DLC for Aeterna Noctis[/h2]

"Pit of the Damned" is the first playable DLC for Aeterna Noctis, and it will take us to explore a new area full of new challenges, new enemies, and, of course, a new and fearsome final boss. The images show the King of Darkness making his way through some catacombs featuring our classic puzzle and level design. Apparently, an ancient evil claims the monarch's presence in that crypt... The visuals speak for themselves, and the DLC feels more Aeterna Noctis than ever! Its launch is scheduled for early 2023.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/dd49675441f76702d57eca2f7aba303f36ce3848.jpg[/img]

[h2]Summum Aeterna Launch[/h2]

Summum Aeterna will end its Early Access period at the end of 2023, with a simultaneous release on PC and PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo consoles. Our Roguelite title will continue to receive new updates such as new worlds, more weapons, and even more challenges over the next few months until its final release at the end of 2023. Check out the roadmap for the next year:

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/d428eea74073ca9d61ce44b4032820b283aba25e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Aeterna Lucis[/h2]

Our fandom had been theorizing for a while about a possible sequel to their favorite Metroidvania. The jewel in the crown during the showcase was a brief, but long-awaited announcement… The confirmation that Aeterna Lucis, the sequel to Aeterna Noctis, is currently under development. We haven't revealed more details for now except 2024 as the launch window. Are you excited?

In conclusion, 2023 is full of surprises for lovers of the Aeterna Universe. A DLC for Aeterna Noctis at the beginning of the year, the multiplatform and simultaneous release of Summum Aeterna at the end of 2023, and the highly anticipated sequel Aeterna Lucis for 2024.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/498bc484e3a90ffc14fcf8d76ba9316a26567a6b.jpg[/img]

Remember that all this is possible thanks to your support!

notes.title: Summum Aeterna, the new game from Aeternum Game Studios, is now available!
notes.content:
By surprise, Aeternum Game Studios announces that its second title "Summum Aeterna" is available today, a frenetic action Roguelite that you can find available on Steam for a reduced price of [b]€15.99 / $15.99[/b] and launched in [b]Early Access[/b]:


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1815230/Summum_Aeterna/

Summum Aeterna is a [b]Roguelite[/b] that combines a [b]world generation[/b] mechanic never seen before in the genre with a [b]frantic combat system[/b] and an art style Very characteristic unique 2D. At the controls of the King of Darkness, you must explore impregnable territories full of treasures, traps, hordes of enemies, and powerful bosses.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/6b1afa58e2a14e6ea8543cfab12703870a9fe7d5.jpg[/img]

This is a prequel to Aeterna Noctis that introduces us to a [b]King of Darkness[/b] in one of the most convulsive and bloody periods of its history. The rhythm of the combat triples the formula seen in Aeterna Noctis, with frenetic action and a variety of weapons being the main components in the combat system of this new title. The game includes significant improvements and assists over the previous title that will make players feel really agile and powerful in combat.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/14d8a95d01e5c399cbe946ecd110ef19df50084c.jpg[/img]

Among the features of Summum Aeterna, stands out a world generation system that has never been seen before in a title of the genre. Worlds are created from seeds (or world generators) that, when germinated, create a new challenge with different environmental characteristics, enemy behavior, special rooms and completely random rewards depending on the genes contained in the seed. The so-called [b]Seed Mechanics[/b] will allow players to enjoy a totally different gaming experience every time they venture into a new world.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42192295/464a562e87ab6da299166ad5fdd878ac3cd75b4a.jpg[/img]


[b]Day One content[/b]

Let's take a look at what is included in the first version of the game currently available on Steam:
[list]
[*] 2 worlds featuring 2 different areas each
[*] 2 final bosses
[*] 1 special room… The Death Roulette! Featuring a mechanic that makes your run even more interesting… Would you spin it? Be careful, it could curse your game or make you unstoppable!
[*] 3 weapon types: swords, scythes, and pistols
[*] 21 unique weapons, each one with different offensive and passive attributes
[*] Introduction to the Seed Mechanic, a unique world generator system: Each seed you find generates a unique world with different enemy behaviour, rewards, special rooms, and map size depending on its genes and rareness.
[*] More than 20 unique world modifiers: The so-called “seed genes” make each seed different from the last, and so will the world generated from them!
[*] Permanent character upgrade system: No matter how many times you’re defeated, your progression in the skill tree will be saved!
[*] Permanent world upgrade system: The world improvements you unlocked will last forever, even if you are defeated a hundred times!
[*] Weapon customization options: Add new attributes and improve the combat performance of your weapons by embedding gems
[*] More than 15 epic music themes
[/list]
Everything mentioned above is already included in the current playable version of Summum Aeterna. We rely on the community feedback to improve the gaming experience. We are willing to include new features based on our player base opinions as well. Feel free to send us your suggestions and share your thoughts!


[b]Project timeline[/b]

Summum Aeterna is scheduled to be in early access for a year and a half, so the full version will be ready at some point in 2024, but there’s no specific end date. However, all main updates for the next months are already scheduled, and the content for the first half of 2023 is almost planned.


[b]Future content scope[/b]

Now that the first version is available, let’s take a look at the future content. Right now we have 4 major upgrades to cover the game progression until the end of 2022. Small patches could also be released between each main update to solve possible bugs or expand the customization possibilities. 

This is the roadmap of our first cycle in Early Access:

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42192295/2eeb239e620ed597282e49580f7b701f708c696f.jpg[/img]


[b]Major Update 1 - July[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 new challenge room that will offer a true combat challenge only recommended for the most skilled players… The Shrines of Idalith!
[*] 3 minibosses
[*] 3 new weapons: Mantis Claw (scythe), Jade Katana (sword), and Taser Gun (pistol)
[*] 2 new NPCs: Rasen Lupine and the Dummy
[*] 1 new seed type: Chance of Worlds
[*] New lethal genes
[*] More gems
[*] Many more surprises!
[/list]
[b]Major Update 2 – August[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 new world (2 currently) including 2 different areas (4 currently)
[*] 1 new final boss (2 currently)
[*] More genes to modify and alter the worlds
[/list]
[b]Major Update 3 - September[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 new world (3 currently) including 2 different areas (6 currently)
[*] 1 new final boss (3 currently)
[*] 1 new weapon type (3 currently)
[*] 8 unique weapons, each one with different offensive and passive features (24 currently)
[/list]
[b]Major Update 4 – October / November[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 new seed type… Exotics Seeds! They will teleport you to a unique world including exclusive features. Would you survive? 
[*] 1 new type of world including a certain challenge to overcome
[*] Inclusion of legendary weapons, allowing access to more than 30 unique tools of destruction!
[/list]
[b]What will come after Major Upgrade 4?[/b]
[list]
[*] We will add more types of special rooms, and some of them will include new upgrade mechanics
[*] Expect more unique variants for each weapon type
[*] More worlds are also on our radar
[*] New gems will be added
[*] More available options in the skill and world tree
[*] All the good ideas provided by the community to make Summum Aeterna even more fun!
[/list]
We will update the roadmap and the next content scope in early 2023. Thank you so much for your constant support! We rely on you to make Summum Aeterna an epic experience.

notes.title: Aeterna Mode vs. Noctis Mode, what is the difference?
notes.content:
If you are a lover of Metroidvania games, in Aeterna Noctis there is a perfect game mode for you, the Aeterna Mode. However, if extreme challenges and platforming are what you want, you are a Noctis Mode player. But do you know what the differences are between these game modes? We explain it to you.

[b]Aeterna Mode (A pure Metroidvania experience)[/b]
In essence, the game has been completely redesigned to offer you as a player a 100% Metroidvania experience where action and exploration are the protagonists. If it's one of your favorite genres, don't miss the opportunity to get lost in a huge open world with 16 unique areas and hundreds of enemies with unique mechanics. The challenge lies in recovering your power and facing fearsome final bosses that will demand the most of you.

[b]Noctis Mode (Platforms and extreme challenges)[/b]
We could say that for the first time two genres such as Metroidvania and platform games have been mixed. Playing on this mode, you will not only have to explore and recover your powers, but you will also face constant puzzles, platform sections and challenges only recommended for the most demanding players. If you think this is not for you, we do not recommend playing on Noctis Mode since frustration can ruin the experience. This mode includes all the achievements, so it is also ideal for completionist players or for those who, after beating Aeterna mode, want to enjoy the title again with more difficulty.

[b]What if I started in Noctis mode and the difficulty is too much for me? Or... What if I started in Aeterna mode but want a more challenging experience?[/b]
The player can switch between one mode or the other at any time without losing progress and reloading the game at the last save point, allowing the Aeterna Noctis experience to be shaped at your will.

[b]Some examples of Aeterna Mode Vs Noctis Mode[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ex5bwSa.jpg[/img]

In Aeterna Mode, the spikes have been removed from the platforms to make it easier to fight the enemy. This way you can slide and lean on the platforms without worrying about environmental hazards.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/orEqt2T.jpg[/img]

In Aeterna Mode, the chainsaw puzzle is replaced by an enemy encounter. This way the gaming experience is more focused on exploration and action, moving away from more challenging puzzles.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z6pXNAh.jpg[/img]

In Aeterna Mode, environmental hazards have been removed so navigation through the level is less demanding and doesn't require pinpoint accuracy.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eTiPfT4.jpg[/img]

In Aeterna Mode, you have more hazard-free space to jump, dodge, and attack enemies. In Noctis Mode, you are required to be more precise with the controls to avoid all environmental hazards, such as spikes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3nCN6Q6.jpg[/img]

Playing in Noctis Mode you have to pay attention to breakable platforms and time your jumps correctly, while in Aeterna Mode you can move more freely without the need for precise jumps and dashes.

[b]Aeterna Mode Achievements[/b]

While all achievements can be unlocked in Noctis Mode, only those story-related ones can be acquired by playing in Aeterna Mode. This is the list of achievements available in Aeterna Mode:

[list]
[*] You are prepared!
[*] Immortality is insufferable
[*] Doctor in da house
[*] The lord of the crystals
[*] Tourist information point
[*] My preciousss
[*] Well gifted
[*] Verbiage
[*] Guns, lots of guns
[*] Do a barrel roll
[*] You are an adult now
[*] Kwik-e-mart
[*] Take another piece of my heart
[*] My soul is in good hands
[*] Play it again, Sam
[*] It's a long way to the top
[*] Gotta obtain them all
[*] I do not like this place
[*] Vertiginous
[*] A loose wire
[*] Extinct the fires
[*] I've been here before
[*] Know thyself
[*] Just pull the plug out
[*] Doppelgänger
[*] Run, you fools!
[*] Stairway to heaven
[*] Hail to the King!
[*] Rest in peace
[*] Alone in the dark
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Diary 4 - The lore of Aeterna Noctis
notes.content:
Hi everybody! It’s Friday at last, the weekend’s almost here! So to celebrate, we bring you a new dev diary with a lot of new details about Aeterna Noctis’ story and lore!

The origin of the conflict between the King of Darkness and the Queen of Light goes back to the times where Aeterna was divided into several kingdoms and other independent states. They all used to have good commercial relationships and live in harmony. But when the soon-to-be King of Darkness took the place of his father as the new duke, everything changed.

One nation after another was conquered by his well trained army, creating a huge empire with lots of territories under its rule. Other kingdoms started doing the same, attacking their neighbours. Only the most powerful remained, and the rest were just annexed to other countries. A decade later, the world of Aeterna was controlled by two main factions: one ruled by the King of Darkness, and the other ruled by the Queen of Light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/ecdded0a13a06b00a700955a381de662658d0ec3.png[/img]

A cold war started not long after that, and tensions between both contingents began to grow rapidly. This escalation resulted in the inevitable great war that shook the foundations of Aeterna and killed thousands of innocents.

The Supreme God and creator of the universe, Chaos, was so disappointed and enraged with the selfish behavior of the mortal leaders, that he decided to intervene. The divine punishment that he chose was to condemn both of them to fight each other through eternity, thus keeping the balance between good and evil.  To prevent them from ever stopping the fight, He cursed them both with immortality. From that moment, not even death could free them from their punishment.

After that, the cycle of rulers started. Each time one of the two monarchs defeats the other, the winner takes the throne of Aeterna. Once they start their reign, they are allowed to wear a crown: a purple one for the King of Darkness and a silver one for the Queen of Light. As for the loser, the opponent is then reborn, powerless, and must recover their abilities, reach the castle, and start a duel all over again in order to reclaim the throne. 

Apart from the kingdom’s history, we also wanted to tell you about three of the different areas that form the game: the Ascension Cave, the Light Tower, and the Heroes’ Rest.

[h2]The Ascension Cave[/h2]

The Ascension Cave is an underground area where the mining companies used to extract minerals and crystals. The mines were abandoned a long time ago due to a worm infestation, so the area is currently formed by zones full of natural crystal formations mixed with deteriorated mining structures and items.
Nowadays, only the bravest adventurers and some goblins dare to venture into the cave, and they use the old rail system to avoid the worms, golems and other enemies while they travel through the large tunnels. No one would want to run into one of these creatures’ nests or burrows by accident if they wander too far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/009fca8202c43591c15e91a3b7920b0c55fa63d0.jpg[/img]

The Ascension Cave tunnels are immediately recognisable by its crystalline aesthetics. The crystals are spread out throughout the entire area in different types of formations, from the classic thin and pointed stalactites to crystalline structures with peculiar shapes. You’ll find these formations everywhere throughout the whole area… except for the tunnels dug by Wormolok, the Giant Worm that inhabits the cave. Its powerful maws can destroy every material, including the crystals and the special minerals from the cave, so the areas where it’s past are completely desolated. 

There is also a beautiful specific area that looks exactly the opposite, as it was almost not exploited by the miners and the crystals look almost virgin. It is “The Crystal Forest”, a zone where the crystals grow in tree-like formations of a charming bright green color. 

Other types of areas you’ll find in the Ascension Cave are goblin settlements, ancient handmade structures, and maybe even Wormolok nests if you dig deeply enough into the area. The deeper you go, the stronger the worm presence is. According to explorers’ stories, yellow mountains of worm eggs block the deeper paths, and Wormolok itself might be guarding the path to the old goblin village.

[h2]The Light Tower[/h2]

The Light Tower is the building where the energy to feed the Queen of Light’s soul is guarded. It’s the highest structure in all of Aeterna and it’s made by pure light essence itself. The energy that the queen’s soul uses is extracted from the Cradle of Light, and it’s then transported to the Light Tower in order to store it and generate the lightnings that recharge her soul every 20 seconds. In order to prevent the destruction of the Light Tower, the lighting is surrounded by a mesh that controls the expansion of the energy charge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/4cc4c292c0b0462f9832289f0cda5d5f2fbd4ce2.jpg[/img]

The Light Tower has a vertical design, so you will have to climb, find stairs, and use the several platforms that provide an ascending path. There are also portals that can be used to reach far distances and get away from the celestial guards that inhabit the tower trying to defend the queen’s energy source.

These guards are not the only threat that you will have to face in the Light Tower. The King of Darkness will be exposed to the lightning every 20 seconds, so you will need to find cover. This energy ray cannot harm the tower structure, so its sides will make the perfect place to find shelter.
Even if the area is a vertical tower, there are also multiple secret rooms and side zones to explore. They can be used to rest a bit after running from a ray discharge, find enemies to collect health points from, or simply to explore a bit before facing the boss level.

Visually, the Light Tower is decorated with motifs that point out the balance between light and darkness. All the columns, sculptures and carvings that fill the structure reference the light soul on the top of the tower. Also, the glass windows allow the sunlight to enter the different rooms creating a beautiful and blazing atmosphere. 
 
[h3]The Heroes’ Rest[/h3]

The Heroes’ Rest is a huge graveyard of fallen warriors. It’s one of the largest areas in the game, formed by cemeteries, old cathedrals, ruined churches and underground tunnels. The area aesthetics are especially dark gothic elements like gargoyles, monoliths and statues of fallen heroes of different races, and a horror atmosphere in general, conveying an extremely unsettling and depressing mood.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/e6f3670751d6974bf7ef046a4428873f0b2885ed.jpg[/img]

The inner levels of Heroes’ Rest also have this terrifying aura. The crypts are the darkest type of levels, and they are full of tombs and spiderwebs that look like they’re decorating the rooms. On the contrary, the cathedrals create a chilling atmosphere due to the stained glass windows that let through the minimum amount of light, creating a beautiful image in contrast to the predominantly green colour palette.

Apart from the faint light from these windows, the main source of light of the Heroes’ Rest is fire. The flames are also present in specific areas like the Burning Library, a depressing but majestic zone.
Heroes' Rest is also full of traps. Falling platforms, sharp objects, spear traps… the area is full of the most difficult puzzles which only the most skilled warriors can overcome. Apart from that, various creatures that inhabit the area will stand in your way. The area is filled with the presence of undead warriors, and there are also insect nests if you dig deep enough to the sewers. These are the narrow corridors located under the surface of the Heroes’ Rest, which are dangerously riddled with waterfalls and creatures.

Now that you know some more of the secrets of Aeterna… aren’t you eager to explore it? You will be able too in just a few months, when Aeterna Noctis releases on December 15th!
